tei:div.tei:p: "$ (367)༄༅// bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid kyi yi ge mdo sngags lam gyi bcud 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(368)༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ rab tu mi gnas ye shes dang*// zab mo rten 'brel chos mkhyen nas// 'jig rten gsum gyi lam ston pa// thub mchog de la gus btud de// stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug lam// rgyal ba sras bcas gshegs pa'i shul// gang de'i khrid yig mdor bsdus pa// bla ma'i gsung bzhin bri bar bya// 'dir lha chos bdun ldan gyi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mnyam med jo bo bka' gdams pa'i thugs dam lha bzhi'i ya gyal bstan pa 'di'i bdag po ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i lta khrid zab mo 'chad pa la/ bshad bya chos ngos bzung ba/ ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul/ skabs don gyi gdams ngag dngos dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje dang ldan pa des gdul bya rnams kyi dbang po'i rim pa dang mthun pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo mtha' yas shing bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bskor ba thams cad kyang bsdu na chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong du 'du/ de'ang bsdu na theg pa (369)che chung gnyis las theg chen la rgyu lam byed mtshan nyid theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu lam byed rdo rje'i theg pa gnyis yod/ rdo rje'i theg pa la dbye sgo mang yang klu sgrub dang jo bo yab sras kyi bzhed pas/ mdo sde rtogs pa'i rgyud dang*/ bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med dang lngar bzhugs/ bya rgyud la rigs drug yod pa'i nang tshan de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la'ang rigs kyi bdag po gtso bo yab yum sogs kyi dbye ba mang du bzhugs pa las/ da lam skabs su bab pa 'di ni theg chen bya rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtso bo'i bye brag tu gyur pa yin no// gnyis pa la/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis chos 'chad pa'i lugs srol gnyis las skabs 'dir dpal ldan a ti sha nyid gang las byung ba'i 'brel gyis/ bi kra ma shī la'i mkhas pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes ltar/ mdzad pa po'i che ba/

chos kyi che ba/ 'chad nyan ji ltar bya ba/ gang 'chad bya'i chos dngos bcas sdom bzhi'i sgo nas 'chad (370)pa la/ dang po chos 'di gang gis mdzad na/ lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dpal ldan a ti sha mar me mdzad ces sa gsum ni sku che ba'i yon tan yongs su grags pa des so// gnyis pa des mdzad pa'i chos de ji lta bu zhig ce na/ dpal jo bo rjes spyan ras gzigs dngos 'brom ston rin po che la lhag pa'i lha grangs med pa zhig gdam nga bskur ba'i tshe/ rin po che'i gling nas yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i lha bzhi gdam par mdzad pa'i thog ma bstan pa 'di'i ston pa/ bdag cag rnams kyi skyabs gnas gcig pu pa ston pa thub pa'i dbang po rdo rje gdan pa'i lha khrid kyi rim pa ste khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'i 'bras bu'i theg pa'o// de'ang 'di dag bya rgyud du 'chad kyang bya rgyud rang rkang tshugs pa'i lugs ni ma yin te ngo bo bya rgyud la/ rnam 'gyur rgyud sde'i rtogs pa bsres pa'o// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa che ba de ldan gyi chos de 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs su bab pa na/ 'chad po slob dpon yang lus ngag yid kyi gnas ngan len spangs te tshul gsum dang ldan la nyan pa po rnams kyang snod kyi skyon gsum/ dri ma drug /mi 'dzin pa lnga la sogs pa spangs nas 'du shes bzhi'am drug sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pas 'chad nyan bya ste skabs 'dir nus na rgyas par 'chad pa gal che'o// bzhi pa bshad bya dngos ni de ma thag par 'byung ba nyid do// gsum pa skabs don nyams len dngos la rgyud smin par byed pa dang*/ smin pa grol bar byed pa'i rim pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba legs par nod do// gnyis pa grol byed khrid kyi rim pa la/ sngon 'gro// dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum gyis nyams su blang bar bya'o// dang po la gnyis/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon (371)'gro'o// thun mong la gnyis/

skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim/ de blo ldog rnam pa bzhi la sbyar ba'i tshul lo// de las dang po ni/ spyir skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi mngon rtogs la sogs pa dkar po'i yon tan gyi chos thams cad skyed par byed pa la bu skyed pa'i ma dang 'dra ba med thabs med pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa tshul bzhin tu bsten pa sngon tu 'gro bas/ las dang las kyi rnam par smin pa la yid ches pas 'jig rten phyi mar myong 'gyur ngan song gi sdug bsngal la 'jigs te bsod nams cha mthun gyi las mngon par mtho ba'i tshul khrims srung ba la sogs pas lha mi'i bde 'bras la sbyor ba skyes bu chung ngu'i lam/ khams gsum gyi gnas mtho dman gang du skyes kyang me'i 'obs dang mi gtsang ba'i dong lta bu sdug bsngal dang de'i rgyu kun 'byung gi bden pa rtogs nas 'khor ba mtha' dag las nges par 'byung ba'i blos thar pa cha mthun gyi las dang lam gyi 'jug ldog tshul bzhin byas pa la brten nas gnas skabs kyi 'gog pa'i bden pa mngon tu byed pa skyes bu 'bring gi lam/ srid dang zhi ba gnyis kar mi gnas pa'i snying rje dang shes rab kyis bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa la bslab cing spyod nas lam lnga dang sa bcu bgrod de mi gnas pa'i myang 'das sgrub pa skyes bu rab kyi lam ste de dag kyang snga ma snga ma la stegs byas nas phyi ma phyi ma'i blo bskyed dgos pas/ skabs 'dir yang go myong gi sgo nas rgyud la 'dre nges su bslab bo// gnyis pa/ gdams ngag pa rnams kyis blo ldog rnam pa bzhir thun mong gi sngon 'gror bsdus nas 'chad de/ de'ang dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa las 'bras rags pa tsam bsam pa dang skyes bu tha ma'i lam dang don gcig /de steng las 'bras phra ba (372)dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa rnams skyes bu 'bring po'i lam dang don gcig

/de dag gi steng du lhag pa'i bsam pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa bsnan pa ni skyes bu chen po'i lam ste/ thog mar khams gsum srid pa mtha' dag la blo ma ldog na/ lam tshad ldan bsgom pa'i snod med pas skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim mtha' dag blo ldog rnam pa bzhir bsdus te rang gzhan thams cad srid las nges par 'byin 'dod kyi blo bcos ma min pa ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom pa gal che'o// de dag gi sgom tshul rgyas pa ni khrid rim gzhan nas 'byung ba nyid ci nus su nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la lnga ste/ lam gyi rtsa ba/ mthun rkyen rdzogs pa/ 'gal rkyen sbyong ba/ byin rlabs 'jug pa thun min bcas kyi rnal 'byor ro// de la dang po lam gyi rtsa ba la gnyis te/ theg pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba skyabs 'gro/ theg chen thun mong min pa'i rtsa ba sems bskyed pa'o// de dag gi go khrid rgyas par 'dir mi 'chad cing bsgom don snying po bsdu na dang po skyabs 'gro la gsum ste yul gang zag 'gro tshul lo// de yang bde ba'i stan la lus gnad dkyus mthun bcas/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro sngar 'byangs zin rung skabs 'dir lam tsam gsal gdab nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul gsal ba ni/ sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams bkod pa tshad med pa'i dbus su 'dod dgu char du 'bebs pa'i dpag bsam shing gi sdong po yal ga lo ma me tog rab tu rgyag pa'i dbus kyi snying por// seng khri pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i ston pa bcom ldan 'das sprul sku'i cha lugs can bzhugs pa'i mtha' bskor ljon pa'i bar mtshams rnams su/ dkon mchog rtsa gsum ye shes chos skyong gi tshogs dang bcas pa sprin 'khrigs pa bzhin tu bzhugs par mos// (373)gang zag gang gis skyabs su 'gro na/ skyabs yul de dag gi mdun tu tshe 'di'i pha ma dang sdang dgra gnod byed kyis gtsor byas/

mkha' khyab kyi sems can ma lus pa 'khod pa'i 'dren dpon rang nyid kyis bya te/ ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ lus gus pas phyag ngag gus pas skyabs 'gro/ yid gus pas dad mos rtse gcig pa'i ngang 'di nas byang chub bar du skyabs su 'gro ba skyes bu chen po'i blo sngon tu 'gro bas/ skyabs 'gro'i tshig rgyas 'bring gang lcog gam/ bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ji tsam nus pa gsog /gnyis pa sems bskyed pa la'ang gsum ste/ dmigs pa'i yul mkha' khyab sems can bsam 'og tu bcug ste/ dmigs pa'i gang zag rang nyid kyis/ dmigs pa'i rnams smon 'jug gi bdag nyid can tu sems bskyed pa ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral te/ myur du bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i blos tshig ris rgyas pa gzhan nam/ bdag gis sbyin sogs la sogs pa brjod cing*/ mthar tshangs gnas bzhi la blo bzhag ste/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ mthar skyabs yul rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gzhan nyes ltung sdig sgrib zhi/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs rgyas/ 'khor rnams 'od du zhu gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo 'od zhu rang la thim/ bla ma dkon mchog gi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems can thams cad dag pa'i zhing du song bar bsam la mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa mthun (374)rkyen tshogs mchog rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ gong du skyabs yul bsdus na tshogs zhing slar gsal 'debs pa'am/ 'on kyang spros pa bsdu na/ skyabs yul mi bsdu bar de nyid tshogs zhing du byas pa'i mdun tu/ ngo bo rang gzhan thams cad kyi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dus gsum du bsags pa ji snyed yod pa/ rnam pa gling bzhi ri rab snod kyi bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa la lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor sogs bcud kyi yon tan ma tshang ba med pa/

grangs sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra ba snyed dang mnyam pa/ rgya nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje can rnams la 'bul ba'i mos pas/ maṇ+ḍal dngos su ngas par bsham ste phyag len ltar rgyas par tshom bu so bdun ma sogs dang*/ bsdu na jo bos mdo las btus par grags pa/ sa gzhi spos byung mas tshar brgya stong du phul ba'i mthar phul ba de dag tshogs zhing rnams kyis bdag gir mdzad/ bdag gzhan thams cad kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs te da lta nyid du 'tshang rgya nus pa tsam du song bar mos/ mthar tshogs zhing rang la bsdu'o// gsum pa 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ rang tha mal pa'i spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdor dril 'dzin cing longs sku'i chas rdzogs pa/ zhabs sems skyil du bzhugs pa'i g.yas kyi mthe bong rang gi smin mtshams la reg pa/ de'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po'i mthar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng dkar pos bskor bar mos la sems cung zad 'dzin/ rgyas par spro na yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed kyang 'gal ba med mod skabs don 'di tsam gyis 'thus gsungs/ spyir sdig ltung sbyong ba la gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang dgos pas de ni rten gyi stobs (375)so// bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig ltung rgyu dang bcas pa la 'gyod cing gdung ba'i blo drag po bskyed/ sun 'byin pa'i stobs sam 'gyod pa des drangs te bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad sbyang bar mdzad du gsol snyam pa'i mos gus drag po dang bcas yid rtse gcig pas gsol 'debs kyi tshul du yig brgya bzlas pas/ thugs rgyud bskul/ sngags 'khor las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong brdol te rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/

lus kyi phyi nang thams cad bkrus/ thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig ltung bag chags dang bcas pa dag par mos/ gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs so// mthar mgon po bdag ni sogs a bhi dha na'i rgyud tshig yin phyir skabs 'dir cung zad mi 'brel bas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdor sems 'od zhu rang la thim pas lus zag med lha'i sku/ sems rtog med chos kyi skur gyur par mos te mnyam par bzhag /phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi dge ba la mi 'jug pa'i bsam spyod la gnas pa ni nyes pa slar lon gyi stobs te de dag dang ldan pa ni sdig pa sbyong ba'i gnyen po'i mchog go /bzhi pa byin rlabs myur du 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sbyor ba rten bskyed pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i gdan la ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma/ rnam pa zhing 'di'i bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po// sku gser gyi gtan pa phyis pa ltar 'od 'bar ba/ chos (376)gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ phyag sa gnon mnyam bzhag /zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba zhig bsam/ de la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sogs skyabs yul yod dgu cog thim pas dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bor mos la/ dngos gzhi gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ gdung shugs drag po dang bcas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag la yun ring bar btab rjes dbang zhu ba ni/

slar yang mos gus drag po bzod par dka' bas bla ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de nyid 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer mi phyed par gyur te dbang gi ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos la bzo med kyi rang ngo bskyang ngo*// lnga pa mtshan bcas kyi rnal 'byor thub pa'i sgom bzlas ni/ sngon 'gro'i rjes thog tu yin na dngos gzhi la 'jug pas chog cing*/ skabs gzhan tu skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sgom pa sngon tu song nas/ swa bhā bas stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du zla ba'i gdan la rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ ser po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ sku las skyes pa'i 'od kyi (377)phung po'i klong na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de ni dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag go /de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po// mgrin par āḥdamar po// thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par bsgom pa ni gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa nye bar bsgrub pa'i yan lag go /de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ zhes pa ni ye shes pa gzhug pa sgrub pa'i yan lag go /slar yang 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri bā ra ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo bzhis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /ye shes kyi bdud rtsis lus gang*/ lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes rgyas gdab pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ste bzhi rdzogs kyis lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med par gsal bar yun ring du sems bzung nas yang nas yang du mnyam par bzhag pa la gtso bor bya/ de la sems mi gnas pa'am skyon bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du muṃ yig gser gyi kha dog can gyi mthar/ nang skor la/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ bar skor la/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ga te ga te pā ra saṃ ga te bo dhi swā hā/ mtha' skor la ye sngags phreng kha dog ser pos bskor ba bsam/ de las 'od 'phros lus gang sdig sgrib sbyang*/ 'od zer phyir 'phros sangs rgyas (378)thams cad mchod/ tshur 'dus sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par mos pa bdag don byin brlabs kyi bzlas pa dang*/ yang 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyang*/ mchog gi go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer rang la thim par mos pa gzhan don phrin las kyi bzlas pa ste/ dmigs pa de dag la sems rtse gcig tu gzhol bas bzlas pa'i dngos gzhi mu ni la bya zhing*/ ga te sum cha tsam dang*/ mthar brtan byed du rten snying tshar kha shas bzlas la/ spro na mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ lha snang yang stong nyid du sbyang*/ 'od gsal gyi ngang la sems ci gnas su bzhag /mthar dge ba bsngo'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ thabs kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems sgom pa dang*/ thabs byung don dam byang chub sems sgom pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ byams pa sgom pa/ snying rje sgom pa/ de dag gi bogs 'don pa/ byang chub kyi sems sgom pa dngos so// dang po ni/ rgyu 'bras kyi man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas rim gyis bsgom pa'am/

mdor bsdu na/ thog mar skye sla ba rtsa ba'i ma la dmigs te 'di bdag gi ma yin/ ma 'dis bdag gi dal 'byor gyi lus dang srog bskyed pa nas brtsams te phan tshad med btags/ gnod pa sna tshogs las bskyabs pa sogs drin che ba'i rgyu mtshan sgo du ma nas bsam la byams pa drag tu bsgom la/ ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa dung dung bya// de la 'byongs nas skye dka' ba tshe 'di'i dgra la bsgom/ de la 'byongs nas rim bzhin rgya je cher btang ste mthar sems can thams cad la bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ ma 'dis 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang thabs la mi mkhas pas 'grub pa (379)sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig 'grub pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu la spyod par 'dug /sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'bras 'di dang bral ba zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam du snying rje shas mi bzod pa tsam du bsgom zhing*/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa dang mi 'bral bar bya/ rgya je che la bslab pa byams pa ltar bya'o// gsum pa de dag gis myong ba ci rigs pa skyes pa na/ bogs 'don tu mya ngan gyi 'dug stangs zhes pa lus tsog pu bya/ lag pa gnyis kyis 'gram pa skyor/ srin lag khar 'dzud/ ma rgan mdun tu bsgom la byams snying rje tshad med pa shugs bskyed la ngag tu 'dra/ nga'i a ma zhes mang du brjod cing*/ de'ang rgya je che la bslab pa dang*/ khyad par du gang snying rje skye dka' ba de la phur tshugs su bsgom par bya'o// bzhi pa don dam byang chub kyi sems ni 'og nas 'byung bas/ 'dir kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems tsam bsgom pa ste/ 'di ltar ma rgan drin can 'di rnams snying rje'o snyam pa kho nas mi chog /phan pa'i lan tu phan gdags dgos par 'dug /phan 'dogs pa po'ang bdag bu sdug pa kho na la bab/ gzhan la khag bsnyad sa med do thams cad ma yin par mtshungs/ phan phyogs re btags kyang phan pa med pas sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya/

da lta de'i nus pa bdag la med pas thog mar thabs zab mo bsgom pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che la bslab par bya'o snyam du bsam pa dngos gzhi dang*/ yan lag tu gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa bdag la len (380)cing*/ bdag gi bde skyid rgyu dang bcas pa gzhan la sbyin te/ de'ang dbugs dbyung rngub dang sbyar la dmigs rnam gsal ba'i phyir du 'od dkar nag gi rnam par spro bsdu byas kyang rung la/ re dogs med pa'i snying rje chen po dang ma bral ba gnad du che'o// spyir blo dman la rgyu 'bras bdun gyi man ngag dang*/ blo rab kyis bdag gzhan mnyam brjes byang sems btsan thabs su bslab par bshad do// lta khrid kyi sngon tu 'di nges par 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ sdud pa las/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su ma rdzogs par// de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtog mi byed// ces pas tshogs bsags pa'i mchog gam phul ni byang chub kyi sems lhag pa'i bsam pa yin pa shes par bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa la gsum/ rten zhi gnas bskyed/ brten pa lhag mthong btsal/ de gnyis zung 'brel du sbyang ba'o// dang po la gsum/ lus kyi gnad bca' ba/ sems kyi bzhag thabs bstan pa/ de las skyes pa'i nyams ngos bzung ba'o// dang po ni/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan 'bol chung sogs nyer bsdogs sngon tu 'gro bas/ rkang pa skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag /rgal tshigs drang por bsrang*/ mgrin pas ol mdud mnan/ lce ya rkan la sbyar/ mig sna rtse'i thad kyi bar snang la 'byed 'dzum med par lta/ sgrim klod ran pa'i lus gnad bcas pa tsam gyis sems dang gnas su 'gro ba la bslab/ de ltar lus gnad bcas pa'i rjes thog tu dbugs dbyung rngub gnas gsum ched du byas pa ma yin pa rang babs su rgyu ba nyid grangs nyer gcig tsam gyi bar du bgrang ngo// gnyis pa la gsum/

rten (381)bcas kyi zhi gnas/ rten med kyi zhi gnas/ ngo bo nyid la 'jog pa'o// dang po la ma dag pa shing bu'am rde'u phra mo la dmigs rten du byas te sems spro bsdu med par che re 'jog /gsal bdo ba'i skabs su 'phro bcad/ yang dmigs rten la 'jog ste sgrims slod ran pos khab mig tu skud pa 'dzud pa ltar yengs su ma shor bar bya/ dag pa lha sku sogs sam khyad par shākya thub pa'i sku che chung ran pa chags tshad dang ldan pa zhig dang mdun nye ring mtshams par bshams te/ byings na gtsug tor/ rgod na skyil krung*/ snyoms pa la thugs kar sems gtad de 'jog /'jog tshul sngar bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ rten can la cung zad goms nas dmigs rten de dag dngos su mi bzhag par yid kyis de 'dra ba zhig bsam pa la sems gtad de 'jog /'di la cha shas kyi rten bcas zhes zhal phyag sogs cha shas re re la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rten bcas zhes sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam cha spyi la sems 'dzin pa ste snga ma goms nas phyi ma la bslab/ gsum pa ni/ dmigs rten de dag gang yang yid la mi bya bar stong nyid kyi dang du dgag sgrub bcas bcos med par chams se 'jog pas yul dang yul can bsgom bya sgom byed sogs rtog pa'i 'phro 'du'i rlabs thams cad kun gzhi'i rgya mtshor thim par ma gyur gyi bar du nan tan chen pos zhi gnas kyi snyoms 'jug la brtson par bya'o// gsum pa de dag las skyes pa'i nyams ngos bzung ba la gnyis/ gzhung gi lugs dang gdams ngag gi lugs so// dang po ltar na nyes pa lnga spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad bsten pas stobs drug gis yid la byed pa gzhi'i gnas skabs can gyi sems gnas dgu grub pa'i mthar/ shin sbyang mi g.yo bar brtan pa la bya'o// de (382)la spang bya'i nyes pa lnga ni/ dbus mtha' las/ le lo dang1 ni gdams ngag2 rnams// brjed dang byings dang3 rgod pa dang*// 'du 4mi byed dang 'du 5byed de// 'di dag nyes pa lngar 'dod do// zhes gsungs pa ltar te/

de la le lo la gnyid sogs snyoms las dang*/ bya ba ngan par zhen pa dang*/ skyid lug pa ste gsum/ bying ba la rags pa dmigs shes kyi grims cha shor nas dmigs rten mi gsal ba'i tham tham dang*/ phra ba gsal cha yod kyang 'dzin stangs kyi shugs zhan pa gnyis/ rgod pa rags pa yul la ha cang chags pas gnyen pos kyang mi non pa dang*/ phra ba g.yo med du mi gnas par cung zad 'phro ba gnyis yod/ de dag spong ba'i gnyen po 'du byed brgyad bsten pa la/ le lo'i gnyen po bzhi ste/ rtsol ba 1dang*/ 'dun pa2 dang*/ rgyu dad pa 3dang*/ 'bras bu des drangs pa'i shin tu sbyangs 4pa'o// brjed pa la gdams ngag 5mi brjed par byed pa dang*/ bying rgod byung ma byung rtog cing 6byung na dmigs pa lta stangs spyod lam sogs kyis sel ba'i thabs la 'bad pa dang*/ byings rgod kyi gnyen po sogs 'du mi byed pa la rtsol sems kyis 'du 7byed pa dang*/ bsam gtan la skyon med pa'i tshe rtsol bas 'du byed na 'du mi byed pa la bslab/ stobs drug bsten pa ni/ thos pa'i stobs1/ bsam pa'i stobs2/ dran pa'i stobs3/ shes bzhin gyi stobs4/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs5/ 'dres pa'i stobs6 te dang pos sems gnas dang po 'grub la/ gnyis pas gnyis pa 'grub/ gsum pas sems gnas gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ bzhi pas lnga pa dang drug pa/ lnga pas bdun pa dang brgyad pa/ drug pas dgu pa 'grub bo// yid byed bzhi ni// sgrims te 'jug pa1/ chad cing 'jug pa2/ chad pa med par (383)'jug pa3/ lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa4 ste sems gnas dang po dang gnyis pa'i skabs su yid byed dang pos 'jug la/ gsum pa nas bdun pa'i bar du gnyis pas/ brgyad pa'i skabs gsum pas/ dgu pa bzhi pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa'o// sems gnas dgu ni/ sems 'jog /kun tu 'jog /nges par 'jog /nye bar 'jog /dul bar 'jog /zhi bar byed/ nye bar zhi bar byed/

rgyun gcig tu byed/ mnyam par 'jog pa ste dgu'o// gnyis pa gdams ngag pa'i lugs kyis nyams lngar 'chad de/ dang po sems g.yo ba'i nyams ri gzar gyi 'bab chu lta bu/ gnyis pa thob pa'i nyams gcong rong chu bo lta bu/ gsum pa goms po'i nyams chu bo dal 'bab lta bu/ bzhi pa brtan pa'i nyams rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba lta bu/ lnga pa brtan pa mthar phyin pa'i nyams rkyen cis kyang mi g.yo bar gsal dwangs su gnas pa mar me rlung gis ma bskyod pa lta bu ste 'chad par nus shing spro na 'di dag gi tshul gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar rgyas par bshad do/ ༈ /gnyis pa lhag mthong gi khrid la gsum/ gang zag gi bdag med sgom tshul/ chos kyi bdag med sgom tshul/ de'i don ngo sprad pa'o// dang po ni/ 'jigs tshogs la lta ba'i ri bo nyi shu la sogs pa 'jig rten na lta ba rnam par ma dag pa ji snyed mchis pa de thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa ni gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa ste/ de'ang gang zhe na/ sems can thams cad la nga'o zhes snyam pa'i lhan skyes kyi ngar 'dzin te/ de bdag med par lta zhing sgom pa la dpyad 'jog gtso che ba'i lugs gnyis yod/ don tu gnyis ka zung 'brel dgos mod kyi gtso che ba'i dbang du byas na/ dpyad sgom (384)pas rgyu la dpyod pa rdo rje gzegs ma la sogs pas rgyu'i bdag med dang*/ 'bras bu la dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog la sogs pas 'bras bu'i bdag med rtogs par mdzad cing*/ 'jog sgom gyi dbang du byas kyang thog mar/ gang zag gi bdag de rang bzhin gyis grub na/ phung po dang gcig dang du ma gang rung du grub dgos kyang de ltar ma grub pas tha snyad du phung po'i tshogs pa la brten nas nga zhes btags pa tsam las/ don dam par rang bzhin gyis grub pa med pa'i tshul la nges shes bskyed pa sngon tu 'gro ba tsam ni nges par dgos so// gnyis pa la/ gzung ba med pa/ 'dzin pa med pa/

spyi bkag pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ bdag ma grub pa de bzhin tu bdag gir bzung ba'i phyi snod bcud dang nang phung khams la sogs pa'i yul ji snyed pa 'di rnams kyang rdul phran 'dus pa las byung bas rags pa ma grub/ rdul phran de'ang brtags na cha med du 'gyur bas phra ba ma grub ste/ mdor na chos thams cad rtog pas phar btags pa tsam du zad kyi don rang ngos nas bden par grub pa rdul tsam yang med de/ bum pa la bum 'dzin gyi shes pas glo bur du btags par zad kyi bum pa gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir bum pa med pa'i snga logs su bum 'dzin gyi shes pa mi skye ba bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ yul la der 'dzin gyi shes pa sna tshogs pa 'char ba 'di dag kyang yul la brten nas byung bas bden par ma grub ste/ dper na rmi lam gyi snang ba rdzun pa'i phyir der 'dzin gyi rmis shes kyang rdzun pa las ma 'das pa bzhin yul rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa la ltos pa'i yul can shes pa nyid kyang bden par ma grub bo// gsum pa ni/ (385)gzung 'dzin dang yod med yin min sogs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad bkag zin pa'i shul gyi spros bral spyi tsam dang shes pa rang rig rang gsal tsam du yang bden par grub pa med de yod med gnyis ka min pa'i phung po gsum pa shes bya la mi srid pa'i phyir dang*/ rang ngos nas spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phyir ro// de dag kyang rgyu 'bras la dpyod pa sogs dpyad pa rgyas par grub na sngar sa bon smos pa ltar ro// gsum pa ni/ de ltar dpyad pa'i grub 'bras snang lugs kun rdzob kyi ngos nas chos thams cad rang rang gi rgyu rkyen rten cing 'brel 'byung las skyes pa'i phyir med pa ma yin la/ gnas lugs don dam gyi ngos nas bdag med/ ngo bo'i rang bzhin med/ rgyu'i rang bzhin med/ 'bras bu'i rang bzhin med/ rten 'brel rang bzhin med/ yul rang bzhin med/

yul can rang bzhin med/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med/ dngos po rang bzhin med/ dngos med rang bzhin med/ snod rang bzhin med/ sems can rang bzhin med de rkyen las skyes pa'i phyir yod pa ma yin la/ de las gzhan tu'ang grub pa med par ngo 'phrod pa de nyid rnam thar sgo gsum gyi mtshan nyid can gyi zhi lhag dbyer med snang stong zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin tu nges shes bskyed par bya'o// gsum pa zhi lhag zung 'brel du sbyang ba ni/ dpyad don ngo 'phrod pa de nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa ste/ de'ang dpyad pas sgro 'dogs chod de yul rang ngos nas spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral zhing bsam gyis mi khyab pa la zhugs pa de'i tshe/ yul can dpyod byed nyid kyang bsam brjod thams cad dang bral ba dper na bud shing zad pa na me zad pa (386)ltar blo'i 'jug pa thams cad gnyug ma rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i ngang du thim nas gnas lugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang du sems sems byung gi spros pa mtha' dag nye bar zhi ba ni mthar thug pa'i 'jog sgom ste/ de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa na lus ngag yid kyi gnad ma 'khrul pa dang ldan pas mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du dang po hril gyis bsgrim/ bar du lhod kyis klod/ mthar rang ngo bzung la mnyam par 'jog /rjes so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis bdag rang bzhin med pa lam du byas te bsgom mo/ ༈ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa rjes ni/ rjes kyi nyams len dngos dang*/ de'i yan lag go /dang po ni/ ji srid mi skyo'i bar du gnas lugs la mnyam par bzhag ste mthar thun las ldangs te/ thun mtshams kyi spyod lam la 'jug pa na/ bsam sgom bgyis pa la sogs pa'i dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la byang chub sems rnam pa gnyis skyes brtan gong 'phel du gyur nas byang chub chen po myur du thob par shog cig snyam pas/

bzang po spyod pa sogs theg chen gyi bsngo smon rnam par dag pas rgyas gdab/ spyod lam rnams su'ang yul snang la a 'thas bral ba'i stong nyid snying rje'i rnal 'byor dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis bskyang bar bya'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ gegs sel dang bogs 'don no// dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin rtse gcig bsgoms pas khams 'dus te rlung stod du 'tshangs pa'am/ snying mi dga'i gegs 'byung bas/ mdun gyi bar snang la a dkar po zhig gsal/ gegs skyon dud 'tshubs lta bu'i rnam par (387)thon nas a la thim par mos te ha sprugs drag tu byas pas sel lo// nad byung na gang na ba'i sar bug pa drwa mig lta bu nas nad rlangs pa'i rnam par bton pa'am/ blo 'byangs na rang gi nad de'i steng du sems can thams cad kyi nad blangs la rang bzhin med pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog /gdon gyis 'tshe na de nyid pha mar thag bcad la btang len bsgom zhing dmigs med du 'jog /gnyis pa ni/ bla ma la bcos min gyi mos gus drag po dang ma bral bas gsol ba yang nas yang du 'debs pa ni bogs 'don thams cad kyi mchog yin pas thabs mang du 'tshol mi dgos/ mdor na skyon yon gang la'ang dgag sgrub mi bya bar rang bzhin med par shes pas rang bab du bskyang ba nyid gnad du che'o// sbyang yon ldan pas nan tan tu// zab mo'i ting 'dzin 'di goms na// skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar 'byin nas// rig dang zhabs su ldan par 'gyur// bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid las thub pa'i lta khrid kyi le tshan no/// / ༈ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ// snyigs ma ldan pa'i zhing spyi dang*/ khyad par gangs ri'i mgon gcig pu// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag der btud nas// de yi rnal 'byor 'dus gsal spel// gnyis pa jo bo bka' gdams pa'i man ngag grub thob skyer sgang pa'i bka' srol dang 'brel pa spyan ras gzigs snying rje mkha' khyab kyi khrid la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum/

dang po sngon 'gro la thun mongs thun min gnyis/ thun mong ba thub pa'i lta khrid ltar 'chad/ thun mong ma yin pa la lnga las/ dang po skyabs (388)'gro ni/ dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i gdan la bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan pas 'khod de/ sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams su gyur pa'i dbus su dpag bsam gyi ljon shing rtse mo lngar gyes pa'i dbus mar seng khri pad zla'i gdan la bla ma spyan ras gzigs kha sar+pa ṇi'i rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ mdun gyi yal gar spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa la yi dam lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ g.yas kyi yal gar sangs rgyas/ rgyab tu chos dkon mchog pu sti'i rnam pa/ g.yon tu theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun bar mtshams rnams su mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs ma lus pa bzhugs par mos la/ rang dang sems can thams cad lus ngag yid gsum gus pa chen pos skyabs su 'gro ba'i blo rtse gcig pas skyabs 'gro'i cho ga rgyas pa/ bdag dang sems can thams cad legs pa'i lam ston bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi'o// sku gsum ngo bo sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zab zhi spros bral dam chos rnam la skyabs su mchi'o// sar gnas lam zhugs dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'gal rkyen kun sel srung ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa'am/ bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan brgya stong du bsags/ gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad yid yul du byas te/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bzhag par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lam (389)gyi rnal 'byor zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ deng nas bzung ste 'gro rnams sangs rgyas bar// rang nyid zhi bde skad cig med par ni// gzhan don smon dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid du// nyin mtshan dge ba'i las la bskul bar bgyi// zhes sam/

bsdu na/ bdag gis sbyin sogs brjod/ gsum pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ lag len ltar legs par bsham ste/ rgyas par na chos chung brgya rtsa las 'byung ba las dze tā ri dang gnyis med rdo rje'i cho ga la sogs pa ltar ram/ de tsam mi nus na tshom bu so bdun ma nas/ bdun ma'i bar dngos su bsham pa de nyid rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bur dmigs la lan grangs mang por phul bas/ bdag gzhan gyi tshogs rdzogs/ sku las 'od zer byung sdig sgrib dag /'gro kun dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ slar mos gus kyi rkyen gyis skyabs yul 'od zhu rang la thim par mos/ bzhi pa rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ dkar po'i 'od kyi 'phro 'dus rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i sku snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ gi mthar yi ge brgya pas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ lus gang*/ sdig sgrib dag /'od zer phyir 'phros/ rigs drug gi sdug bsngal sdig sgrib sbyang*/ tshur 'dus rang la thim par mos te gsal snang la mnyam par 'jog pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa bzla ba ci nus su bya/ mthar mi dmigs par bzhag /lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma (390)spyan ras gzigs dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad dkar/ zhabs sems skyil/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ 'od zer mu med par 'phro ba'i gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ mchod 'os thams cad spyan drangs te thim/ yid kyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ mos gus kyi yid rtse gcig pas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma spyan ras gzigs la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus su bskyar/ mthar bla ma'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can gyi rgyun bab/

rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus thams cad 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas bla ma'i gsang gsum dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed par gyur pa mos la rang ngo bskyang ngo*// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mtshan bcas lha bsgom pa dang*/ mtshan med de kho na nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'o// dang po la gnyis te rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni bde ba'i stan la lus rnam snang chos bdun nam rang lugs kyi skyil krung sogs mdor na bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'khod/ rlung ched du rtsol ba med pa rang babs su bzhag /sems g.yo med dwangs gsal gyi ngang la gnas/ gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ rten srung (391)'khor bsgom pa/ brten pa lha bsgom pa/ lha'i gsal snang 'don pa/ bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul ba'o// dang po ni/ rang gi mal gyi phyogs bzhir hrīḥdamar po mgo gyen bstan re re/ steng 'og gnyis su hrīḥdamar mgo gyen dang mthur bstan re gsal/ mdun gyi hrīḥ'od kyi mig mang ris yol ba lta bur zhu/ de las 'od zer g.yas kyi hrīḥl phog /de'ang sngar ltar zhu/ de'i 'od nub/ de'i 'od g.yon tu pog nas hrīḥzhu ba sogs sngar ltar dang*/ steng 'og gi hrīḥyang 'od du zhu/ 'gebs dngas gzhi'i rnam par gyur te/ 'od zer gyi drwa ba dang khor yug can gyi gzhal yas khang bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang mi thar ba'i phyi rol du me ri rtse mo kha dog sna lnga pa can gyi gur khang gsal la brtan pa yun ring du bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i lte bar a dkar po// de 'od du zhu/ lus kyi nang gang*/ 'od zer phyi rol du 'phros/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyang snod kyi 'jig rten 'od du zhu/

bcud la thim/ de'ang rang la thim/ rang lus kyang mtha' nas dbus su yal bar mos te stong nyid kyi ngang du bzhag ste/ oṃ swa bhā ba sogs chos nyid rnam dag gi sngags brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid hrīḥdakar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa de 'od du zhu ba las thig le dkar po gsum du gyur te/ de'ang dbus che/ g.yas g.yon gnyis chung ba/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las gtso 'khor gsum du gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba ltar kun nas dkar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa (392)zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can// dbu skra phyed dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi steng na mar 'phyang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pas mu tig gi phreng ba 'dren cing*/ g.yon gnyis pas ut+pal dkar po snyan gyi thad kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su jo bo nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ dang po gnyis thal sbyar/ g.yas 'og mas rin po che dbang gi rgyal po yu ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yon gnyis pas rin po che'i 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ pus mo btsugs nas spyan gnyis jo bo'i smin phrag tu gzigs pa/ g.yon tu jo bo yi ge drug ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ pus mo btsugs shing spyan gnyis jo bo'i thugs kar gzigs pa'o// gtso bo'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po// de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas jo bo gtso 'khor gsum mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a ba lo ki te shā ra sa pa ri bā ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ jo bo thugs rje chen pos bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don tu phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol (393)ba lan gsum btab pas dam tshig pa so so la thim par bsam/ gsum pa la gnyis/ rtsa ba'i lha la gsal snang 'don pa dang*/ snying rje mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin sgom tshul lo// dang po ni/ de ltar gsal ba'i lha sku'i snang ba lam me ba de la sems bzung*/ de'i gsal snang ma shor ba'i ngang*/ res gdan nas gtsug gtor bar/ res gtsug tor nas gdan gyi bar/ res spyan gyi dkar nag lta bu phra ba nas rags pa'i bar/ res rags pa phyag zhabs nas phra ba spyan gyi bar du gsal gdab/ de dag brtan nas lha snang spyi la sems gtad de mthar ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad ma 'dres par shin tu gsal zhing blo rtse gcig pa la brtan pa thob par bya ste dmigs pa'i dngos gzhi'o// gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid pad zla'i steng na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ sku yis zhing khams thams cad du khyab cing zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho sku la rdzogs par lam gyis gsal ba'i sku lus kyi sgo ba spu'i sgo nyi ma'i 'od ces pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig du ma dang*/ gser gyi ri khri/ re re la yang rtse mo khri nyis stong*/ rin po che'i khang bzang skyed tshal rgyan bkod du mas brgyan pa/ yi ge drug pa'i chos sgra sgrog pa/ ba spu de'i nang na yang rgyal ba'i dbang po zhes bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu na/ lha'i gser gyi ri brgyad khri rin po che'i brag ri ljon shing dag dang*/ zas gos lha'i rang bzhin las grub pa la byang chub sems dpa' dag longs spyod cing*/ yi ge drug pa'i chos sgra sgrog go

/ba spu de 'das pa na sman chen po (394)zhes bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed ma thag bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong*/ rdo rje/ dngul/ gser/ in+d+ra nī la/ pad+ma rā ga margad/ shel gyi ri rtse mo brgyad khri yod pa/ dri za'i sil snyan gyi sgra las yi ge drug pa'i chos kyi dbyangs 'byin cing*/ gang sems thog ma bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa sems te/ kye ma'o zhes sdug bsngal skye rgas na 'chi sogs la skyo bas skyil mo krung bcas te lus drang por bsrang nas dran pa mngon par bzhag nas ri de dag la 'khod do// ba spu de yang 'das pa na/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu na rang sangs rgyas pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma me 'bar ba dang*/ char 'bebs pa sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston cing*/ rin chen sna bdun las grub pa'i ri'i rgyal po brgya phrag stong dag la 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i dpag bsam sdong po/ rtsa ba mu tig /lo ma gser dngul/ me tog man shel las byas pa dag las rgyan cha du la dang kā shi ka'i gos rnams 'phyang ngo*// de 'dra ba'i ri rnams la rang sangs rgyas dag bzhugs nas gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyang yi ge drug pa'i sgrar ston no// thams cad kyi tha ma na ba spu'i khung bu rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal po ni/ rin po che'i ri brgyad khri bzhi stong dang*/ dpag bsam dang tsan+dan dang byi ru'i shing de snyed yod cing rin chen 'bar ba'i khang brtsegs na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'dzam bu'i gling bu mngon par phyogs shing chos 'chad pa/ phar phyin drug yi ge 'bru drug tu ston par mdzad pa yang bzhugs pa sogs (395)mdor na skra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed kyi/ sangs rgyas byang sems bzhugs nas la las ni dam pa'i chos kyi 'gro ba mdzad/ la las ni phar phyin drug dang ldan pa'i chos 'chad/

la las ni rdzu 'phrul rnam par rtse ba'i cho 'phrul ston la thams cad kyang yi ge drug pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog cing de dag las byung ba'i 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig ba spu'i sgo bye ba phrag brgya nas byung ste/ 'gro drug gi sdig sgrib bag chags ma lus pa sbyang*/ kun kyang jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sku 'ba' zhig tu song nas yi ge drug pa'i sngags ti ri ri bzla bar mos te rtse gcig dmigs pa'i ngang dang ma bral bar mnyam par 'jog go /bzhi pa ni/ de ltar bsgom pas ting nge 'dzin la gsal snang thon pa'am/ sgom pas skyon bzlas pa la 'jug ste/ rang gi thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad kha steng 'og tu lta ba'i ltag sprod/ gyen lta'i dkyil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dkar po// de'i mtha' bskor du oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes pa'i sngags phreng dkar po g.yas skor du 'khod par mos la rang nyid kyis bzlas pa byas pas/ sngags kyi sgra sems can thams cad kyi rna bar lhang lhang byung*/ don skye med kyi ngang du 'jog bzhin tu yi ge drug pa ci nus su bgrang*/ slar thugs ka'i sngags phreng 'od zer du zhu/ ngo bo yig 'bru la rnam pa 'od zer gyis spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sang sang dag /'od zer phyir 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong bar bsam/ yang sngags (396)phreng sngar ltar gsal btab cing bzlas pa dang 'od du zhu ba'i dmigs pa spel ma ji tsam nus pa bya/ mthar gong du bshad pa'i snying rje mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin sgom la bzlas pa ci nus byas te/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe yi ge rnams pad+ma ltag sprod la thim/ de hrīḥl thim par mos/ gnyis pa mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ bcud kyi sems can la phog /de 'od du zhu/ de las 'od 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten la phog

/de dag 'od du zhu/ mtha' nas 'dus te 'khor gnyis la thim/ de gnyis gtso bo la thim/ de nyid yas mar nas zhu/ thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ de'ang 'a chung ra la/ de ha la/ ha mgo bo// mgo bo gi gu/ de nā da la thim/ de yang 'od du yal ba'i ngang la cig nas su bzhag /mi gnas par 'phro bar brtsams pa na/ stong pa'i ngang las thig le gsum/ de'i dbus ma hrīḥ /de las gtso 'khor gsum/ snod gzhal yas khang*/ bcud lha yi rang bzhin tu mos/ 'di la ched du sbyang na/ slar bsdu zhing mnyam par 'jog ste lhar ldangs pa sogs sngar ltar bya'o// gsum pa rjes la gnyis/ rjes kyi rnal 'byor dngos dang zhar byung gi rnal 'byor gzhan bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bsgom bzlas ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor grub nas/ rjes spyod lam la 'jug pa na 'khor gnyis rang la thim/ rang phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis kha zas thams cad 'bru gsum gyis ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab ste rang lhar gsal bas longs spyod/ gos lha'i gos pañtsa li kā ra bsam te tshogs rdzogs pa'i yan lag tu spyad/ 'gro (397)'dug sems can la phan pa 'ba' zhig tu mos la bsngo smon rgyas par bya ba sogs theg pa chen po'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral bar bya'o// gnyis pa zhar byung gi rnal 'byor la gsum/ khyad par bde stong gi rnal 'byor/ thun mong byang sems kyi rnal 'byor/ lam gyi chad mthud 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po/ rang jo bor gsal/ mdun tu lha mo yi ge drug ma bsgom/ de'i smin mtshams su thig le dmar po// de las 'od zer dmar po tsha ba'i ngad ldan byung*/ rang gi smin mtshams su phog /rang gi mgrin pa nas 'od zer dkar po bde ba'i ngad ldan byung*/ lha mo'i lte bar phog /'od dkar dmar 'dres pa sku lus nang nas yar song*/ slar smin mtshams nas 'od dmar po// rang gi smin mtshams su thim pa sogs 'khor lo ltar bskor bas yab yum gnyis kar bde stong gi nyams skyes par bsam la/

bde ba ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom zhing bde ba skyes na stong pa dang bsre// stong nyams kyis bde ba yal na slar 'od 'khor bsgom la bde ba bskul/ mthar stong pas rgyas gdab/ 'di bya rgyud rang lugs kyi thabs lam dod bltas pa'i bde ba lam byed kyi rnal 'byor ro// gnyis pa ni/ dang po rang gi mdun tu rtsa ba'i ma de bsam/ ma 'dis bdag gi lus srog bskyed pa nas bzung*/ tshe rabs thams cad du phan pa chad med pa btags/ gnod pa tshad med pa las bskyab pas drin re che snyam du bsam la byams pa tshad med (398)pa bsgom/ ma 'di thog ma med pa nas 'khor ba 'dir sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'bras 'ba' zhig la spyod cing thar dus ye med pa snying re rje snyam du snying rje tshad med pa bsgom/ ma 'di bdag kho nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral te bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang la nges par 'god par bya'o snyam du byang chub kyi sems tshad med pa bsgom/ de la 'byongs nas dgra bgegs dang*/ sems can mtha' yas pa la mtshungs par sbyang ngo*// gsum pa la sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi mdun nye ring 'tshams par thugs rje chen po'i sku mtshan nyid dang ldan la yid chags pa bris 'bur gang rung bkram pa'i mdun tu mchod pa bsham/ de thugs rje chen po dngos su gsal la mchod bstod bya/ bdag la re sa khyed las med do snyam pa'i blo gtad ling bskyur byas la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs so// rnam shes bde chen tu 'pho bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan mang du btab/ rang gi rnam shes hūm̐ dkar por gyur pa sna bug g.yas nas rgyangs kyis thon/ jo bo'i shangs bug g.yas nas thugs kar zhugs par mos la der sems 'dzin/ slar shangs bug g.yon nas byung*/ sna bug g.yon nas snying gar zhugs/

yang sna bug g.yas nas 'phangs pa sogs 'khor mang sbyang*/ mthar thun 'jog pa'i tshe hūm̐ rang gi snying gar thim pa'i rjes jo bo rang gi spyi bor byon/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsol ba gsol ba gdab pas/ jo bo 'od du zhu/ tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rang lus bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang bas (399)'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang*/ rgas pa med pa'i lang tsho dang ldan par mos la bsngo smon bya/ gnyis pa ni// nges par 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe nyer bsdogs sngar ltar byas la/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa mi dge ba'i rigs la bshags sdom yid tshims par bya/ lus longs spyod maṇ+ḍal du phul te zhen 'khris rbad kyis bcad la chags zhen dang blo ma bde ba spu tsam med par bya/ rang gi rnam shes hūm̐ dkar po sna bug g.yas nas thon pa sogs sbyang ba'i skabs ltar la/ jo bo'i thugs kar thim tshe 'od gsal gyi ngang du bzhag /slar rnam shes tshur 'thon pa'i dmigs pa mi bya bar yang yang 'phang*/ des kyang 'pho ma nus na/ rang lus kyang 'od du yal te jo bo'i thugs kar sib kyis thim par mos te sems rtog med du bzhag pas/ rab 'od gsal du grol/ 'bring dang tha ma lha dang mir skye/ 'ja' 'od dang ring bsrel sogs ltas bzang po 'byung bar bshad do// khrid 'di stan thog gcig tu bsgom pa'i tshe mtshan bcas rnal 'byor gyi skabs/ thog mar snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdus nas/ slar srung 'khor dang lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa byas na lag len bde zhing don dang mi 'byor ba med do gsungs/ dal 'byor yon tan brgyad ldan lus// snying po len 'dod skal bzang dag /ma nor lam mchog 'dir zhugs shig /ting 'dzin rgya mtsho myur thob 'gyur// bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid las spyan ras gzigs snying rje mkha' khyab kyi khrid kyi le tshan no// /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ phongs pa kun la dus drug tu// pu gcig ltar brtse rje (400)btsun ma// snying gi ze'u 'brur rtag mchod de// rjes dran lnga yi khrid 'chad bya// gsum pa bka' gdams rin po che'i bka' srol las byung ba phrin las kyi lha 'phags ma sgrol ma rjes dran lnga'i khrid 'chad pa la gsum/

sngon 'gro// dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gnyis te skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed do// dang po ni/ bsam gtan la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba spyi ltar la/ thun mong sngon 'gro gsal gdab pa sogs dge ba'i sems khyad par can gyis go phyes te/ sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rang mdun dpag bsam shing gi sdong po yal ga lngar gyes pa'i dbus mar rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la bla ma 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can la rtsa brgyud bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pas bskor ba/ mdun tu seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma la yi dam lha tshogs/ g.yas su sangs rgyas/ rgyab tu dam chos/ g.yon tu dge 'dun/ mtha' bskor du mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs bcas gsal gdab/ sems can thams cad yid yul du byas te/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma ci nus su brjod pas skyabs su 'gro/ gnyis pa ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rje btsun sgrol ma'i go 'phang la bkod par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ bdag gis sbyin sogs mang du brjod/ mthar skyabs yul las 'od zer byung*/ rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ yon tan spel/ skyabs yul 'od zhu rang la bsdus te mnyam par 'jog // ༈ /(401)gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga ste/ skyabs gnas bla ma/ lus lhar/ ngag sngags/ 'gro kun pha ma/ sems chos nyid du rjes su dran pa'o// de'ang rgyal ba 'brom rin po che la bka' gdams lha bzhi zhal gzigs pa'i dus su/ sgrol ma'i zhal nas/ sras kyi thu bo spyan ras gzigs// khyod kyi rjes 'brangs kho mos bskyab// kho mo'i gdams pa 'di longs la// rjes su 'brangs la bstan par gyis// skyabs gnas bla ma dran par mdzod// lus ni lha yi rang bzhin te// ngag gi bzlas brjod rgyun tu mdzod// 'gro ba ma lus pha mar soms// sems kyis gnas lugs stong par dpyod// lnga po 'di yi skya bar nas// dge rtsa thams cad dag par mdzod// ces gsungs pa'i bstan don rjes dran lnga'i zab khrid du grags pa ste/

de la'ang rjes dran dngos dang*/ phyi nang gsang ba'i go bab bshad pa gnyis/ dngos kyi dang po bla ma rjes su dran pa la gsum/ sbyong ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sbyor ba rnal 'byor gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gi snying gar snang ba kun rdzob thabs kyi ngo bo snod kyi thig le ser po sran ma bkas pa'i dbyibs lta bu/ de'i steng du stong pa don dam shes rab kyi ngo bo bcud kyi thig le gser mdog 'od lnga 'phro ba yungs kar gyi dbyibs can che chung snod dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can/ de'i spyi bo nas tho brtsegs su pad zla'i gdan chung ngu reg la ma 'byar ba re re'i steng du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can (402)tu bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyi steng mar jo bo rje dngos bsgom/ jo bo'i dbu gtsug nas pad zla'i gdan gyi phreng ba kha gsum gyes pa'i dbus mar rdo rje 'chang*/ tai lo/ nā ro/ ḍom+bi pa sogs nyams len byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa dang*/ g.yas mar byams pa thogs med sku mched sogs rgya chen spyod brgyud dang*// g.yon mar 'jam dbyangs nas klu sgrub yab sras sogs zab mo lta rgyud rnams jo bo la thug gi bar phreng bar bstar te bzhugs pa/ de dag gi gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rtsa brgyud bla ma dang dkon mchog thams cad spyan drangs gnyis su med par thim pas dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid du mos/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi tshogs bsag cing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bdag gzhan gyi lus zhing rdul grangs snyed du sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ lus longs spyod kha rje dbang thang dus gsum gyi dge rtsa dang*/ 'jig rten na mchod pa'i yo byad ji snyed yod pa thams cad kun tu bzang po'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin lta bur blos blangs te 'bul ba sogs yan lag bdun pa'i dmigs bsam rnam par dag pa la gnas te/

thun mong ma yin pa 'brom rin po che'i gsung*/ phyag dang phyag yul gnyis stong pa'i// rnam dag sku la ye phyag 'tshal// sogs bka' gdams glegs bam las 'byung ba ltar grub na legs/ thun mong bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa byas kyang rung la/ gang ltar bsags sbyong spel gsum gyi gnad bsdus pa'i tshogs bsags de nyid sngon tu 'gro ba'i mos gus rtse gcig pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba (403)dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan mang du gsol ba btab/ gsum pa rjes dbang blang zhing de kho na nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ mthar mos gus drag po'i rkyen gyis rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lam gyis byung*/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib spyi dang khyad par lam gyi ye shes skye ba la 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa mtha' dag sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis gong 'phel du rdzogs/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam// mthar gong ma 'od du zhu ste 'og ma la rim bzhin thim/ mthar rtsa ba'i bla ma yang bde ba chen po'i ngo bor zhu nas snod bcud kyi thig le la thim/ de'ang mi dmigs pa blo 'das brjod bral gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngang mdangs bskyang ngo// gnyis pa lus lhar rjes su dran pa la gnyis/ lha skur bsgrub pa dang*/ gsal snang la bslab pa'o// dang po yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis lha'i skur bsgrub pa ni/ swa bhā bas stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa tshad med pa seng ldeng nags tshal me tog 'bras bus brgyan pa'i ljon shing du mas gtib pa'i dbus su/ pam las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃ las ut+pal ljang sngon tāṃ yig gis mtshan pa/

de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun 'phags ma seng ldeng nags (404)kyi sgrol ma sku mdog ljang ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal sngon po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ rin po che dang dar gyi na bzas brgyan pa/ zla ba'i rgyal yol can/ dbu skra li ba zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs can/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin can tu gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang*/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i tāṃ yig ljang gu/ de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ lha dang lha min sogs kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas yum bzhi bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa byung ste/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan par gyur/ spro na sngar ltar mchod bstod kyang bya/ 'dir yan lag bzhi sbyar tshul ni thub pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa dmigs pa'i gtso bo lha'i gsal snang la bslab pa la gnyis*/te/ rtsa ba'i gsal snang 'don pa dang*/ de la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ de(405)ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrub pa'i lha sku de nyid snang la rang bzhin med pa/ gsal la ngos bzung med pa/ bde la zhen pa med pa gsal lam mer yang nas yang du gsal gdab la/

rnam pa spyi'i gsal snang ma shor ba'i ngos/ bye brag phra ba nas rags pa'i bar dang*/ rags pa nas phra ba'i bar gsal gdab la sbyang ste snang yul du dngos su gsal ba lta bu'i gsal snang la brtan pa thob cing*/ ji tsam 'dod kyi bar du gnas su btub pa'i gnas cha brtan po ma byung gi bar du nan tan tu sbyang ngo*// gnyis pa la'ang gnyis te thun mong dang khyad par ro// dang po ni/ sngar bsgom pa'i thugs ka'i tāṃ bskyar nas gsal gdab/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad ba mo la nyi zer phog pa bzhin tu sbyangs/ tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas/ sangs rgyas thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa rgyun mi chad par phul/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad 'od zer dang lhan cig tshur byung ste rang la thim par bsgom/ yang 'od zer 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*/ bcud kyi sems can rje btsun sgrol ma'i skur gyur bar mos// gnyis pa khyad par ni/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi dmigs pa skabs 'dir bya/ de'ang 'og gi las sbyor gyi skabs su 'byung ba nyid 'dir blang bar bya ste/ 'on kyang bzlas pa'i rigs dngos su mi dgos pa ni/ skabs 'dir khyad par ro// gsum pa ngag sngags su rjes su dran pa la'ang gsum ste phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o// (406)dang po la gsum/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor ro// dang po la bzlas pa'i gzhi 'god pa dang dmigs pa dngos so// dang po ni/ rang sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la tāṃ yig sngo ljang*/ de'i mthar yi ge bcu pa yig ngo nang du lta ba g.yas bskor du 'khod pa mos la gsal brtan tu ma gyur bar bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ lus thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/

tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas/ 'od zer phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ 'od zer tshur 'dus/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad thob par mos te yi ge bcu pa'i bzlas pa ci nus su bya ba ni bdag don byin rlabs kyi bzlas pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ sngags las 'od zer 'phros/ rigs drug gi sdig sgrib bag chags bsal/ snod bcud snang la rang bzhin med pa 'phags ma'i zhing khams rten brten par bcas par gyur/ khyad par ba spu'i bu ga nas rang 'dra ba'i sgrol ma nam mkha'i khams khyab par spros/ 'gro drug gi sdug bsngal rgyu bcas bsal/ bde ba'i gnas la bkod par bsam ste yi ge bcu pa'i bzlas pa ci nus su bya ba ni gzhan don phrin las kyi bzlas pa'o// gsum pa ni/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi bzlas dmigs bya ba ste/ re re bzhin bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul bas rang gi thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'jigs skyob so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i 'od 'phros smin mtshams su slebs pa dang 'od kyi sne las so so'i sku dpag med (407)'phros pas mkha' khyab 'gro kun phyi nang gi 'jigs pa las dbugs dbyung*/ tshur 'dus rang la thim par bsam pa thams cad la 'gre'o// 'jigs brgyad so so la/ seng ge'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma seng gdong mche ba gtsigs shing lce glog ltar 'khyug pa/ spyan ser mo mdog dmar zhing skra ser ba/ thugs kar mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sems can rnams nga rgyal seng ge'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsam/ glang po'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma glang gdong shangs mtho zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba du ba'i mdog can/ mthe bong mngon par brkyang ba/ phyag gnyis kyis sdig par mdzad pa/ sems can rnams gti mug glang po'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ me'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma dmar mo 'bar ba'i gdong pa can zhal bdun/

ljags bdun/ skra gyen tu 'bar zhing*/ phyag gnyis kyis pad+ma'i phyag rgya mdzad cing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sems can rnams zhe sdang me'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ sbrul gyi 'jigs skyob sgrol ma kha dog nag mo sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bcu dang ldan zhing skra grol ba/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ sems can rnams phrag dog sbrul gyi 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ chom rkun gyi 'jigs skyob sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal khro gnyer bsdus pa/ skra gyen tu brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri/ g.yon sdigs mdzub/ rgyan gyis brgyan nas bzhengs pa/ sems can rnams ltas ngan chom rkun gyi 'jigs (408)pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ lcags sgrog 'jigs skyob sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo// g.yas pa dang g.yon pa lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin cing rgyan gyis brgyan nas bzhengs pa/ sems can rnams ser sna lcags sgrog gi 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ chu'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo// phyag g.yas pa lcags sgrog /g.yon sdigs mdzub/ zhi ba'i skur bzhengs pa/ sems can rnams 'dod pa chu'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ sha za'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ kun+da dang zla ba'i mdog can/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas g.yon mchog sbyin dang mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ sems can rnams the tshom sha za'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom la/ re re la'ang mos gdung dang 'brel bar yi ge bcu pa bzlas la/ tā ra tā ra zhes gnyis kyi sngags 'di dang*/ mthar tā rā mkhyen brtses brjod do// gnyis pa nang gi bzlas pa la'ang gnyis/ thun mong dang*/ khyad par ro// dang po thun mong 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ rlung ro bsal/ rlung rtsol med rang bab gyis nang du 'jug pa oṃ dkar po// gnas pa āḥdamar po// phyir 'gro ba'i tshe hūm̐ sngon por mos la ci nus su bgrang ngo// gnyis pa khyad par yi ge bcu pa'i rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/

rlung ro bsal/ rlung rang bzhin gyis nang du 'jug pa yi ge bcu pa dkar po// gnas pa yig bcu dmar po// ldang ba yig bcu sngon por bsam la bgrang ba'o// gsum pa gsang (409)ba'i bzlas pa la/ spyir ni sgra mthar bsam gtan zhes bya ba gong du ngag bzlas kyi skabs de dag gam dmigs bsal du yang rung bar yig bcu'i sgra dril bu'am ting shag lta bu'i sgra mtha' ha'i skad je phrar yal ba la sems gzhol ba dang*/ khyad par yi ge bcu pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum sems kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo dang gnyis su med pa la sgra ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rang bzhin la blo bzhag par gsungs so// ༈ /rtsa ba'i bzhi pa 'gro kun pha mar rjes su dran pa la gsum ste/ byams pa bsgom pa/ snying rje bsgom pa/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ thog mar skye sla ba rtsa ba'i ma la dmigs/ de nas skye dka' ba dgra lta bu/ de nas mkha' khyab kyi sems can la dmigs te/ de'ang mar shes/ drin dran/ drin bzo ba'i sems sngon tu 'gro bas/ ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang nges par ldan par gyur cig snyam du smon lam dang 'brel ba/ ma 'di rnams bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam du 'dun pa dang 'brel ba/ ma 'di rnams nges par bde ba dang ldan par bdag gis bya'o snyam du dam bca' dang 'brel ba'i tshul gyis nges pa ma skyes par du bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar bde ba dang mi ldan pa de gang las byung na sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las byung bas/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig pa'i smon pa/ bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i 'dun pa/ bral bar bya'o snyam pa'i dam bca' ste snying rje tshad med pa 'brel ba sum ldan gyis nyams su blang*/ gsum pa ni/ de lta (410)bu'i byams snying rje la brten nas sems can thams cad kyi don tu sangs rgyas 'thob 'dod kyi smon sems dang*/

de'i ched du sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu dang khyad par lam zab mo 'di nyid sgom pas nyams su blang ste mthar dbyung bar bgyi'o snyam du bsam pas sbyang*/ sbyor bas nan tan tu de la 'jug pa'o/ ༈ /rtsa ba'i lnga pa sems stong par rjes su dran pa la gsum/ zhi gnas bsgom/ lhag mthong btsal/ de zung 'brel du nyams su len pa'o// dang po ni/ lus kyi gnad rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan pas/ ngag gi gnad dbugs 'jug gnas ldang gsum rang bab nyer gcig tu bgrang ba sngon tu 'gro bas/ sems kyi gnad rten bcas shing bu rde'u lha sku yig 'bru sogs dang*/ rten med dmigs rdol yid kyis bsam pa dang*/ dmigs rnam gang yang yid la mi bya bar ngo bo nyid kyi ngang du 'jog pa rnams la bram zes skud pa 'khel ba'i gnad grims lhod ran po'i tshul gyis nan tan tu bsgom ste byings rgod byung na bcos pas sems gnas kyi rim pa dgu dang 'brel ba'i nyams lnga po rim gyis skye bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa la gsum/ gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ chos kyi bdag med la nges pa rnyed par bya ba dang*/ zung 'brel du nyams su blang ba'o// dang po ni/ 'khor ba rnams la lta ba ngan pa rtag chad du lta ba la sogs pa'i rtsa ba lhan skyes kyi ngar 'dzin la gang zag gi bdag ces bya ste/ de nyid phung po lnga la brten nas brtags pa tsam las don dam par grub pa med pa'i tshul la lung (411)rig man ngag gis sgro 'dogs bcad de nges shes bskyed do// gnyis pa ni/ ngar 'dzin gyi shes pa des bskyed pa'i nga yir 'dzin pa/ phyi'i don tu snang ba dang*/ don de 'dzin byed kyi shes pa dang*/ 'dzin pa bkag pa'i shul gyi shes rnam spyi tsam yang bden par grub pa med de ri bong gi rwa ma grub pas rwa'i rno brtul la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid gdags su med pa bzhin no// gsum pa ni/

de ltar dpyad pas chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i lhag mthong dri ma med pa de nyid/ man ngag gi myong ba dang sbyar te chos thams cad dmigs pa med cing brjod pa dang bral ba'i ngang du mnyam bzhag spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i stong pa nyid dang*/ rjes thob stong nyid rten cing 'brel 'byung du shar ba'i tshul la blo nges par byas te dran pa dang shes bzhin gyi rgyun bskyangs pas bden gnyis zung 'jug gi rtogs pa rnyed par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa rjes dran lnga po de rnams phyi nang gsang ba'i zab don dang sbyar te 'chad na/ dang po rang la thar pa'i lam ston pa ni phyi'i bla ma/ lta spyod zung du 'jug pa ni nang gi bla ma/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can ni gsang ba'i bla ma'o// gnyis pa lhag pa'i lha mtshan dpe'i skur snang ba ni phyi'i lha/ gzhi dam tshig par bskyed pa nang gi lha/ lam ye shes pa dang gnyis su med pa gsang ba'i lha'o// gsum pa sngags kyi gdams ngag tu brjod pa phyi'i bzlas pa/ rlung yi ge'i rnam par bsam pa nang gi bzlas pa/ sgra mtha'i bsam gtan yid byed ni gsang ba'i bzlas pa'o// bzhi pa 'gro drug pha mar shes pa ni phyi'i byang sems/ dmigs pa (412)med pa'i snying rje chen po ni nang gi byang sems/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong nyid snying rje'i rang mdangs tsam du shes pa ni gsang ba'i byang sems so// lnga pa lung rig la brten nas chos thams cad stong par sgro 'dogs chod pa ni phyi'i chos nyid/ myong thog nas gsal stong zung 'jug mngon tu gyur pa ni nang gi chos nyid/ sems kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de nyid chos kyi skur shes pa ni gsang ba'i chos nyid rjes su dran pa yin no// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gnyis te dngos dang*/ zhar byung ngo*// dang po ni/ rang lhar bsgom pa yin na bsdu rim dang thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang ba/

gnas gsum srung ba sogs spyi ltar byas/ dkyus gcig tu bsgom na byang sems kyis mtshams sbyar ba sogs mdor na thun mtshams la bab pa na/ theg pa chen po'i smon lam dang 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo bas rgyas gdab ste/ spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe snang grags rtog gsum rje btsun 'phags ma'i gsang ba gsum gyi lam khyer dang ma bral bar bya'o// gnyis pa zhar byung stan thog gcig ma'i nyams len ni/ sngar bshad pa de rnams stan thog gcig tu bsgom na/ skyabs sems dang bla ma rjes dran sngon tu 'gro bas/ lha sgom sngags bzlas ji ltar rigs pa'i rjes lha sku'i gsal snang 'od gsal du bsdus nas sems kyi gnas lugs stong par rjes su dran pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de las thun mtshams kyi lha skur ldang ba na/ 'gro kun pha mar rjes su dran pas dmigs pa med pa'i byams snying rje byang sems kyis mtshams sbyar te bsngo (413)smon gyi rgyas gdab cing*/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med tshogs gnyis zung 'jug gi lam la 'bad pa 'don par bya'o// lhar bcas yon gnas bka' gdams pa'i// thugs dam chos kyi bcud 'di la// nan tan 'bad nas byang chub kyi// spyod pa rgya mtsho mthar phyin smon// bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid las sgrol ma rjes dran drug gi khrid kyi le tshan no/// / ༈ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ// ye shes khros pa sgyu ma'i gar// 'jigs byed bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms pa// mi g.yo mgon la phyag byas te// khrid tshul spyi dang bye brag 'chad// grub pa'i spyi mes sa ra has 'phags pa klu sgrub la bstan cing rim par brgyud pa dpal ldan a ti sha'i thugs dam gyi mchog tu gyur pa mi g.yo chos drug tu grags pa khyad par ba dang*/ gdams ngag thun mong ba'i lugs kyi khrid rim dag gung spros te 'chad pa la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum/ sngon 'gro la'ang lnga ste/ skyabs sems/

maṇ+ḍal/ yig brgya/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ tshogs gsog gi rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gnyis te/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ lam log pa las skyong ba ste go don blo la nges par bsgom don dmigs par bya ba ni/ sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams gnas khang mtho khyad bkod mdzes kyi dbus su dpag bsam gyi sdong po yal ga lnga pa'i snying por seng khri pad zla'i gdan la/ bla ma mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i rnam pa can/ mdun tu yi dam mi g.yo ba/ g.yas su rgyal ba shāka thub/ rgyab tu glegs bam/(414)g.yon tu theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun/ mtha' bskor dang bar mtshams su mkha' 'gro chos srung so so'i gtso bo la so so'i rigs mthun gyi 'khor dang bcas te bzhugs pa'i mdun tu/ bdag dang mkha' khyab 'gro ba sgo gsum dang mos kyi 'jug pa gcig tu dril bas skyabs su 'gro bar mos te/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma ci nus brjod/ sems bskyed pa ni/ lam dman pa las khyad par du byed pa ste/ sems can de rnams la snying rje chen pos kun nas bslang ste byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa sogs don yid la dran bzhin tu brjod/ gnyis pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ byang chub bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen gyi gtso bo tshogs rdzogs par byed pa ste/ skyabs yul de dag tshogs kyi zhing du byas pa'i spyan sngar/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal rgyu bzang la bkod pas mdzes par bsham pa de nyid rgyur byas te/ yid kyis sprul pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi bkod pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi stobs las byung ba lta bu dang*/ bdag gzhan kun gyi dus gsum gyi lus longs spyod dge ba'i dngos po thams cad kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin tu blos blangs la 'bul te/ tshom bu so bdun ma sogs ji ltar rigs pa dang*/ sa gzhi spos byugs sogs grangs bcad du phul/ mthar skyabs yul rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag gzhan gyi sgrib gnyis sbyangs/

tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sems can thams cad dag pa'i zhing du 'khod/ skyabs yul g.yas bskor tshul gyis 'od du zhu/ bla ma la thim/ bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim pas lus sems zag med kyi sku dang ye shes mngon tu gyur ba mos/(415)gsum pa rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ byang chub bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen gyi gtso bo sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa ste/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdor dril 'dzin pa/ longs sku'i rgyan ldan zhabs sems skyil gyis sku las skyes pa'i 'od phung gi klong du bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig dkar po'i mthar yig brgya'i sngags phreng g.yas su bskor ba gsal gdab/ gsol ba btab pa'i tshul gyis yig brgya bzlas pas ngo bo thugs rje yul la 'jug pa'i ye shes/ rnam pa bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun bab pas lus kyi phyi nang bkrus/ sdig sgrib bag chags nad gdon la sogs pa dag pa'i dmigs rnam spyi dang mthun zhing*/ mthar bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas sogs sdom sems dang 'brel ba'i gsol ba btab pas/ sdig sgrib dag par dbug dbyung bstsal te 'od kyi rnam pas rang la thim par bsam/ bzhi pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor la rten 'brel sgrig pa ste/ rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i rnam pa skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gsal ba la mos gus gdung ba'i shugs drag pos/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs gsol 'debs gang shes ci nus su byas pas/ bla ma'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dang byin rlabs thams cad thob/ mthar bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim (416)par mos te thugs yid bses la mnyam par bzhag /lnga pa tshogs bsags pa la gsum/

sbyor ba tshogs zhing bskyed pa/ dngos gzhi tshogs gsog cing gsol ba 'debs pa/ rjes dbang blang zhing rang la bstim pa'o// dang po ni/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon tu 'gro bas/ rang mdun nam mkhar pad nyi'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po thol gyis byung*/ de la sems cher gyis gtad pas de nyid 'od du zhu ste gtum chen mi g.yo ba sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yas ral gri phyar zhing g.yon rdo rje'i zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdig mdzub thugs kar gtad pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ sbrul dkar po'i ga sha/ stag sham sogs khro bo'i chas can tshems kyis ma mchu mnan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pas bgegs rgyal glang po'i sna can brdzis pa/ khro chung dang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid du mos/ gnyis pa ni/ yid kyis phyag dang lha mo me tog ma la sogs pa dpag tu med pa sprul te mchod cing bstod pas mnyes par bsam/ mos gus dang bcas te ngag tu/ jo bo mi g.yo bas bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ gsang sngags mtha' dag nyams su len tu rung ba'i snod du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bde stong zung 'jug gi rtogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan grangs mang du brjod/ gsum pa ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mtheb chen nas zag med kyi bdud rtsi dkar nar gyis thon te byung*/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad mer gyis khengs/ bde stong zag (417)med kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes par mos la sems bzung*/ mthar yig brgya brjod de mdun gyi yi dam 'od du zhu/ rang la thim par bsam mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ thun mong du lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang thun mong ma yin pa chos drug gi rnal 'byor ro// dang po la bzhi/

bskyed rim gsal snang dang bcas pa/ thun mong mi dmigs/ khyad par gzigs stangs/ thun mtshams srung ba'i rnal 'byor ro// de la dang po lha yi skur bskyed cing gsal snang la bslab pa ni/ bde ba'i stan la lus gnad bcas/ oṃ swa bhā ba sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ chur 'dus pa las skad cig gis rang nyid gtum po chen po'i lha'i skur wal gyis gyur pa ni/ sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri phyar zhing*/ g.yon rdo rje'i zhags pa dang bcas pa'i thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbu skra sma ra smin ma dmar ser gyen tu 'bar ba/ dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gnyis 'khyug cing tshems kyis ma mchu mnan pa/ rin po che dang klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan cing*/ sbrul dkar pos ser khar byas pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas bgegs kyi rgyal po glang po'i sna can gyi steng nas brdzis pa/ sprul pa'i khro chung du ma'i 'phro 'du dang*/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i gnas gsum (418)'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ /dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ mchod cing gsol ba btab pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /spyi bor mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i rnam pas rgyas btab par mos la/ lha sku'i snang zhen la yun ring du sems bzung*/ rnam pa spyi dang bye brag re re nas gsal brtan tshad du ma phyin gyi bar du gsal snang kho nar 'bad pas bslab bo// gnyis pa thun mong du me dmigs gsum bsgom pa ni/ rang lhar gsal ba de'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar yi ge bcu pas bskor ba gsal gdab/

de las drag po'i me lcai 'jigs dus bskal pa'i me ltar/ tsha ba/ rtsub pa/ drag pa/ rno ba/ stobs ldan/ shugs can/ myur ba ste mtshan nyid bdun ldan 'bar/ thog mar hūm̐ sngags phreng dang bcas pa me nang du 'ur gyis 'bar zhing*/ de las kyang me lce 'khyog pos rang gi lus nang dmar mer gyis gang bas sdig sgrib nad gdon bag chags dang bcas pa skad cig gis bsregs par bsgom/ me dmigs dang po'o// de nas me cher 'bar te lus kyi sgo dgu nas kyang me lce sbrul gyi lce ltar dmar myug myug byung*/ mthar ba spu'i bu ga'i sgo thams cad nas kyang dmar lam lam mched/ phyi'i me ri'i gur khang 'dres pas mi mthun phyogs rnams cham gyis bsregs par mos/ me dmigs gnyis pa'o// de las kyang cher 'bar te 'dom dang mda' rgyang dang rkyang grags dang dpag tshad kyi bar du lhab lhab 'bar zhing mched pas bstan dgra gdug pa can rnams dang*/ (419)nad dang dal yams kyi bdag mo mthu mo che rnams rgya mtsho'i mthar bskrad cing byer bar dmigs/ me dmigs gsum pa ste de dag gi skabs su sngags yi ge bcu pa ci nus su bzla'o// gsum pa spyan gyi gzigs stangs la brten nas bden gnyis zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor la bslab pa ni/ rang khro bo'i dbang por gsal/ mig g.yas pa steng du btegs pas spyan g.yas pa'i nang du yi ge maṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zhig bsam/ des sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dang*/ rgyu 'bras rten 'brel 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la gzigs par bsam/ mig g.yon pa 'og tu gnon pas spyan g.yon pa'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhig bsam/ des chos thams cad ci yang mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gzigs par bsam/ mig gnyis thad kar lta stangs gtod pas spyan de gnyis kyi dbus su ye shes kyi spyan khra hu re ba zhig byung*/ des thabs shes dbyer med/ zhi lhag zung 'jug /rtag chad yod med la sogs dbyer med zung 'jug sa ler gzigs par bsam la rtse gcig mnyam par bzhag go

/bzhi pa ni/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gis lha snang 'od gsal du bcug /stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rang lus ye shes kyi ral gri sngo sang me 'bar ba/ yu ba gser gyis gzhi la thug cing rtse mo tshangs pa'i 'jig rten tu sleb pa/ nang stong sang nge ba'i dbus su rang sems hūm̐ sngon por gsal ba la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag /mthar stong par bsdus te thun (420)mtshams kyi lha skur langs la gnas gsum srung ba sogs spyi ltar ro// drag las dang gral dpon byed pa/ phyogs ngan tu 'gro ba sogs dgos pa dmigs su bsal ba yod na rang lus ral grir bsdom bzhin pas bya ba byas na bar chad dang phyogs ngan la sogs pa'i gnod pa gang gis mi tshugs shing*/ lar sba ba gsum tshang ba'i gdams ngag 'di shin tu zab pa yin gsungs so// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor chos drug la/ dang po bde drod gtum mo'i rnal 'byor la'ang gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ skyabs sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngon tu 'gro bas/ lus gnad me thab drug chings bya ste/ rkang pa bol gong bsnol la tsog pur sgyed pu ltar gzug /lag gnyis zhag pa ltar bsdam/ mgo bo phru ba ltar dbug /rgal tshigs mda' ltar bsrang ste g.yo 'gul med par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ rlung gi rnal 'byor dang*/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po khyab byed rlung gi rnal 'byor la bslab pa ni/ rang mi g.yo bar lam gyis gsal ba'i sku'i nang dar sngon gyi gur phub pa lta bu stong chen sgrib thogs dang bral ba'i rkang mthil gnyis su me rlung gi ngo bo rang rig dmar ljang re re gsal gdab/ rlung ro bus/ steng rlung dal gyis rngub/ 'og rlung bskum pa dang rkang mtheb gnyis cung zad bskyod pa'i rkyen gyis rim gnyis las me rlung nar gyis byung*/ brla'i rtsa bo che brgyud de lte 'og tu sleb pa dang*/

srog rtsol thur sel bcas lhan cig tu 'dzom pa la shes pa gtad de dgang zhing gzhil/ mi thub (421)tsa na dal bus sangs kyis bus/ de ltar sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyis rlung 'byongs pa'i rtags ma byung bar bsgom/ gnad phra mo ni/ zhal dang phyag len las shes so// gnyis pa khyab bya gtum mo'i rnal 'byor la gsum/ drod kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ bde ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ mi rtog pa'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po ni/ pus 'khyud btug la nya bzhi bsgrim pa sogs lus gnad sngar las grim cha che bar bya/ stong ra gsal gdab/ lte 'og sor bzhir chos 'byung dmar nag zur drug pa'i dbus su a shad dmar po gsal/ rlung ro bus/ rlung sngar bzhin bzung bas rkang mthil gyi raṃ las me byung*/ sum mdor 'dres pas chos 'byung dros/ a shad las me 'bar ba'i drod kyis lte ba'i 'khor lo nas rim par drod tsha 'ur gyis byung bar mos la thun bzhi sogs su brtson 'grus bskyed de lus la drod ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ stong ra'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma gro sog 'bring po'i tshad tsam pa/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan/ yar sne tshangs bug dang mar sne gsus pa'i gnyer po cher sleb pa'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo dang g.yon tu rkyang ma dkar mo gnyis dbu ma las ba lnga pa 'gyur gyis phra ba/ yas sna spyi bo nas sna bug gnyis dang*/ mas sna lte 'og nas dbu ma'i mar sner chud pa/ dbu ma'i yar sner haṃ dkar po mgo bo mthur bstan phyed nub tsam/ mar sner a dmar po mgo gyen bstan phyed nub tsam/ lte ba'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar po// rtsibs drug la a shad dmar po re re/ mar sna'i a'i steng thad du ram dmar po zhig (422)bsam/ rlung ro bsal/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung bas a bskul/ raṃ las me zangs khab lta bu gyen tu 'bar bas 'khor lo g.yas su drag tu bskor/

hūm̐ yig a shad dang bcas pa las me 'bar ba/ rno ba/ myur ba/ tsha ba/ 'u ru ru 'bar ba la dmigs pa gtad de drag la yun thung du sbyang*/ lus stod tshad pa'i yul yin pas ma 'byong bar du thog ma nas me dmigs rigs stod du mi bya gsungs/ rlung gtong ba'i tshe dbu ma nas yar song bar bsam la nas dbyibs su gtang*/ thun 'jog dus me rnams raṃ la bsdu/ thun re re la bum pa can ci nus khams dang sbyar nas brtson pas de la brtan pa thob pa na me lce rim par bsring ste snying ga tsam du sleb pa dang*/ spyi bo'i haṃ g.yos/ bde ba skyes par mos/ snga ma la brtan pa thob nas phyi rim bzhin 'bar 'dzag bya ba rigs 'gre bas/ me mgrin bar sleb pa dang haṃ dros/ bde ba cher skyes/ spyi bor sleb pa dang haṃ zhu la khad lta bur gyur/ bde ba de las kyang che bar skyes/ me lces haṃ la reg ma thag tu thigs pa gcig 'dzag /me mthur du ded/ hūm̐ la thim/ bde ba tshad med skyes/ thigs pas hūm̐ la reg ma thag me snga ma las kyang cher 'bar/ spyi bo'i bar du song ba sogs 'bar 'dzag 'bros 'ded ma'i dmigs pa dang*/ mthar bde drod kyis lus thams cad kyang khyab pa la sems gtad de bsgom mo// gsum pa ni/ de dag gi skabs su drod dang bde ba dngos su skyes na de la zhen 'dzin ma zhugs par mi rtog pas lam du byed cing stong pas rgyas gdab ste gnyis snang chos nyid kyi ngang du nub pa la brtson par bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni spyod lam thams cad du sngags spyi (423)dang khyad par gtum mo'i dam tshig la gnas shing bde drod kyi nyams dang ma bral bar 'jam rlung bzung la gtum mo zas su za/ lus gdan gos sogs mer bsam pa dang*/ nyal ba'i tshe yang khyi nyal sgor mo'am/ yang na seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis rting pa g.yas pas 'og sgo dgag /dbugs sha dbrag tu 'ong bar byas te gos su gyon/ 'gro ba'i tshe rdo spar bar tshud tsam pa bcangs/
