rlung ro bsal te steng rlung ran tsam mnan pa ni rta ru zhon pa'o// de ltar bsgoms pas dang po drod skye/ de la brten nas bde ba/ zung du 'jug pa las mi rtog pa skye/ de gnad kyis zin pas 'od gsal mtha' dbus med pa nam mkha' lta bu 'char bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa tshod 'dzin rmi lam rnal 'byor la gnyis/ bzung ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// thog mar bzung ba la'ang gsum ste/ dang po kha zas ran cing gos srab la mal bde bar bya/ bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul zhing rmi lam zin pa dang 'byong ba'i gsol ba drag tu gdab/ rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po btang*/ nus na tsog pu dang mi nus na seng ge'i nyal stabs bya/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i smin mtshams su sa'i thig le ser po sran ma'i ga'u tsam pa/ phyed nang du nub cing phyed phyir mngon pa la sems gtad de gnyid log pas zin no// des ma zin na chu'i thig le dkar po// des kyang ma zin na me'i thig le dmar po// de la'ang ma zin na rlung gi thig le sngo skya la sems gtad/ de rnams kyis ma zin na gnyis pa 'dun pa drag tu bya ba ste/ nyin par gyi snang ba thams cad rmi lam yin snyam pa dang*/ ngag tu'ang ngag nyid du song ba'i rmi (424)lam du 'dug ces pa la sogs pa brjod cing*/ cis kyang ma 'khrul bar bya snyam pa la sogs pa'i dran 'dun drag po rgyun chad med pa byas pas nges par zin no// da dung yang ma zin na gsum pa dmigs pa sbog chog gi gnad ni/ dran bdun sogs sngar ltar la nyal khar snying pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su zla ba la hūm̐/ mdun tu a/ g.yas su nu/ rgyab tu ta/ g.yon tu ra rnams sngo skya dwangs par bsam la sems yun ring gtad/ nyal khar thog mar hūm̐/ de nas a sogs g.yas bskor gyis gnyid du 'gro khar ra la sems gtad de nyal bas nges par zin par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa sbyor spel sprul bsgyur zhing khams lta ba sogs rgyas par chos drug gzhan dang mthun/

mdor bsdu na/ zin pa la brtan pa ma thob bar du 'og ma brtsam yang don mi 'grub cing*/ nam bzung ba'i tshe zin pa rtsal sbyong gcig las mang por spel ba/ mang po gcig tu sdud pa/ rang nyid dngos po dang sku gzugs yig 'bru phyag mtshan sogs su sprul pa dang*/ pho rmis na thugs rje chen po'am mi g.yo ba/ mo sgrol ma/ chur bying na sa gzhi/ thog bab na me tog gi char pa/ me chur bsgyur/ chu mer bsgyur ba sogs/ khyung du sbrul nas 'phur te dag pa'i zhing khams lta ba la sogs pa gang 'dod du bslab bo// khyad par rmi lam ngos zin pa na nyin par gang la goms pa'i dge sbyor dang bsre ba gnad du bsnun pa dang*/ rmi lam gyi lus sgyu ma lta bu'i lha sku'i sbyong ba la gtso bor byed cing*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par lta ba'i thog nas rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid shes pa zhig nges par gal che ste/ dge sbyor 'di'i grub don gnyid kyi stong pa'i 'od gsal las rlung sems tsam gyi lha sku sgyu ma lta bu skad cig (425)gis ldang ba goms pas/ 'chi srid 'od gsal las rlung sems tsam gyi bar srid 'char ba de sgyu ma'i skur ldang bar 'gyur ba'i ched du bshad pas so// gsum pa kun rdzob sgyu lus kyi rnal 'byor la/ sgom don dmigs pa'i gnad dang*/ ngo sprod pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ ma dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba dang*/ dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba'o// dang po ni/ rang gi mdun tu me long g.ya' med pa mtho skor las mi chung ba zhig bzhag /de dang rang gi bar du chu snod dwangs pa zhig kyang bzhag pas ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad gsal ba'i dgos pa yod gsungs/ de nas me long du 'char ba'i rang gi gzugs brnyan la mig dang sems yun ring du che re gtad/ de dang rang lus phar bsre/ nyams shar ba de nyid rang lus dang tshur bsres te dbyer med du byas la bsgom/ sgyu ma'i nyams 'byongs na thog mar me long gi gzugs brnyan la bstod smad sna tshogs byed par bsam// de la chags sdang mi 'dug na rang thog tu len/

de la'ang dga' mi dga' med par mgo snyoms na dngos su tshogs pa mang po'i gseb sogs su brtul zhugs sbyong la sbyang*/ de la'ang chags sdang mi skye bar mnyam khad de song na 'byongs pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ me long chu snod sogs sngar ltar la/ yi dam gyi sku brnyan phyag mtshan sogs g.yas g.yon go ldog pa zhig rang gi rgyab tu bshams nas gzugs brnyan me long la 'char ba byas/ de la mig yid gtad de snang yang bden par ma grub pa'i sgyu ma la nges shes bskyed de yun ring du bsgom/ de la sems zin nas lha sku de rang dang me long gi bar du yod par bsgom la sgyu mar sbyang*/ goms nas de (426)nyid rang lus dang bsres te rang lus lha sku snang stong sgyu ma gzugs brnyan lta bu bsgoms pas/ 'byangs pa'i rtags khyad par gsum ldan tu 'byung ste/ sku mdog bar snang la 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bu snang la rang bzhin med pa/ rgyan cha lugs me long ngos su gzugs brnyan shar ba lta bu gsal la ma 'dres pa/ snang tshul chu nang zla ba shar ba lta bu yul thams cad la khyab pa ste/ de ltar 'byangs nas snang ba thams cad la bsre zhing 'byangs par ma gyur bar bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ rim lnga las/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan gyis// sgyu ma'i lus ni shes par bya// kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu// khyab pa chu yi zla ba'o// zhes pas snang tsam nas bden pas stong pa'i gsal snang khyad par can la sgyu lus zhes bya zhing*/ de lam du byed pa na/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sgyu ma'i rang gzugs su snang ba ni tshig don gyi sgyu lus te thos pas gtan la dbab/ yul snang dang tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum sgyu mar sbyong ba phar phyin dang thun mong ba ma dag pa'i sgyu lus dang*/ de dag lha sku sgyu ma lta bur bsgom pa rdo rje theg pa thun mong ma yin pa dag pa'i sgyu lus te/ spyi don gyi sgyu lus de dag bsgoms pas nyams su myong bas/

mthar rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i lha skur ngang gis ldang nus pa sbas don gyi sgyu lus kyis mtshams sbyar nas rtsa rlung thig le sgrib bral du dag pas 'ja' lus sgyu ma'i sku can slob pa'i zung 'jug rgyu dang*/ 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyis las nyon rtsa ba nas sbyangs te dri bral sgyu ma'i longs sku mi slob pa'i zung 'jug 'bras bu'i tshul gyis 'thob par 'gyur ba ni mthar thug gi sgyu lus so// (427)bzhi pa don dam 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor la gnyis/ dngos dang zhar byung ngo*// dang po la'ang bsgom don dang ngo sprod do// dang po la ril 'dzin dang rjes gzhig gnyis kyi/ dang po ril 'dzin gyi 'od gsal la bslab pa ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis lus thams cad gang*/ lha sku de nyid stod nas smad dang*/ smad nas stod du 'dus te thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de yang zhabs kyu ha yig la/ ha mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ de'ang nang shin tu phra bar bsdus te sems yun ring du bzung*/ mthar de yang yal bar mos la rtog med kyi 'od gsal la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag ste de ltar yang yang bskyar la sbyong ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ rang lha'i sku sngar bzhin gsal/ snod dang bcud thams cad me long la has btab pa yal ba ltar dus gcig tu 'od du zhu nas/ rang yang hūm̐ la bsdu ba sogs gong bzhin bya/ 'od gsal mi zin pa'i rgyu spang zhing zin pa'i rgyu bsgrub la de ltar yang nas yang du bsgom zhing*/ khyad par gnyid du 'gro khar nan tan tu bsgoms pas srab mthug gi 'od gsal gang rung zin cing rim par je brtan tu 'gro'o// gnyis pa ni/ rgyud blar/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa// de ni nam mkha' bzhin tu 'gyur med do// zhes gzod ma nas rnam par dag cing rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i chos khams nyid 'od gsal gyi mtshan nyid/

de lam du byed pa na/ tshig gi don gnas lugs gzhi'i 'od gsal de nyid lung rig gis dpyad pa dang nyams myong gi stobs kyis chos thams cad skye med stong nyid du (428)rtogs pa phar phyin dang thun mong ba'i spyi don gyi 'od gsal/ ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gang rung gis chos thams cad 'od gsal du 'jug pa rdo rje theg pa thun mong min pa'i spyi don gyi 'od gsal goms shing 'dris pa las/ rlung sems dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum las byung ba'i dpe'i ye shes myong thog tu rang ngo 'phrod pa sbas don gyi 'od gsal gyis mtshams sbyar nas/ chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa slob pa'i gnas skabs dang*/ chos thams cad ye shes su rdzogs te 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pas chos sku klong 'byams su gyur pa ni mi slob pa'i gnas skabs te mthar thug gi 'od gsal lo// khyad par lam sgom pa'i tshe srab mthug nyams rtogs kyi 'od gsal 'char tshul sogs dbye ba phra mo na gzhan las shes par bya'o// gnyis pa zhar byung zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor la bslab pa la gnyis te/ bsgom don dang*/ ngo sprod do// dang po ni/ de'ang gong smos dag pa'i sgyu lus dang 'od gsal dag gi grub don gyi tshul du 'byung ba ste/ mnyam bzhag tu lha sku snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa la blo bzhag pa'i snang cha de dang*/ de nyid dmigs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid kyi ngang du bsdus pa'i stong cha de nyid/ rjes thob tu zung du 'jug pa'i tshul gyis/ rtog med kyi 'od gsal de las rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i lha sku snang stong sgyu ma lta bu rang shar ba la bslab pa la skabs 'dir zung 'jug gi brdar bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ bden gnyis dbyer med tshig don gyi zung 'jug thos pa la brten nas/ stong dang rten 'byung dbyer med du rtogs pa ni phar phyin pa'i (429)spyi don dang*/

ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gang rung las lha skur ldang ba sngags thun min gyi spyi don gyi zung 'jug ste/ de las rlung dbu mar thim pa'i stong pa bzhi bskyed nus pa nas dpe'i 'od gsal dang sbas don gyi sgyu lus thob ste/ rlung sems lha sku snang stong du ldang ba sbas don gyi zung 'jug dang*/ sa dang po nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar slob pa'i zung 'jug bcas grub nas/ mthar dag pa gnyis ldan gyi yul dang yul can gyi 'od gsal brten pa chos kyi sku dang*/ rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i rten gzugs sku longs spyod rdzogs pa gnyis kyang ngo bo gcig la ldog pas tha dad du dbye ba ye shes kyi sku ni mthar thug gi zung 'jug ste/ de ltar na/ sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug rnams thog mar tshig don la brten nas shes rab khyad par can gyis spyi don nyams su blangs shing*/ thabs khyad par can rlung dang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor sogs kyis bskyabs pas sbas don 'grub/ de las slob pa dang mi slob pa mngon tu 'gyur ba ni nang gi sa lam bgrod pa zhes bya'o// lnga pa lam gyi chad mthud 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor la gnyis/ sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// dang po la gsum/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'pho ba'o// dang po lus gnad dang ldan pas rang lhar gsal ba'i stong ra'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yar sne tshangs bug tu thug pa la haṃ mgo bo mthur bstan gyis bkag cing*/ mar sne lte 'og tu phug rdugs su yod pa/ snying gar smyug ma'i tshigs 'gag pa lta bu'i pad+ma'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi rlung sems kyi ngo bo mi g.yo ba'i sku tshon gang pa 'phar yed yed byed pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ sngo skya spus bris (430)pa lta bu gsal/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma mi g.yo ba spyan drangs/ rang gi spyi gtsug tu bzhugs pa la yid kyis phyag mchod 'bul/ ye shes gong 'phor 'gyur ba'i gsol ba 'debs shing mos gus drag tu bya 'og sgo 'then/

tshigs pa bsrang*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag lte 'og tu bcar/ rlung ro bsal la/ rlung nang du mnan pas snying ga'i yi dam cung zad yar btegs par bsgom/ de bzhin bum can khug pa re res yar yar btegs nas mthar spyi bo'i haṃ la reg reg 'dug par mos/ slar snying khar phab la rlung btang ba bcas de ltar rtags ma thon gyi bar du 'gro ldog spel mar sbyang*/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe tshangs bug haṃ gis bkag /yi dam snying gar brtan par bzhugs par mos/ gnyis pa ni/ lus gnad rlung sbyor dang ldan pas yi dam wal gyis bsgom/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ brjod pas/ chos thams cad sgra brnyan tsam du bsam/ phaṭa ces brjod pas sems nyid brag cha yal ba lta bur bsam/ dge bshes sne zur ba sku 'da' khar/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing cung zhig bzhugs nas/ phaṭa ces gsung nas spyan gyen la hrig mdzad nas gshegs/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu rlangs pa ja khog kha phye ba tsam byung skad/ 'di 'pho ba kho nar ma zad mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod pa bar chad byung dus kyang bsgom pas 'phral du zhi bar gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ gzhan sngar sku'i 'pho ba dang khyad med cing dmigs pa'i bsgyur so snying khar sku bsgom pa'i tshab tu/ rlung sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngo skya 'og nas haṃ dmar pos 'degs shing*/ steng nas ka dkar po mgo mthur bstan gyis gnon pa'i tshul du bsam/ rlung bzung*/ yid (431)kyis ka zhes dal bur brjod pas kas yar 'then/ haṃ zhes drag po'i tshul gyis brjod pas his 'phul nas rlung khug re re bzhin je mtho je mtho/ mthar haṃ la reg reg 'dug /ka zhes drag por yid kyis brjod pas des gnon te snying khar bab pa bsam/ 'phros sngar bzhin sbyang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ 'chi bslu sogs kyis mi zlog pa'i 'chi ltas byung ba na/ nyes byas la bshags sdom/ lus longs spyod ma chags ma zhen par bla ma dkon mchog la phul te dag pa'i zhing khams su 'gro ba'i 'dun pa spro dung nge bas/

'chi ba la bab pa na/ dmigs pa'i gnad snga ma rnams las rang gi goms cha gang la che zhing skabs der yid yul du 'char gang bde ba zhig la gnad du bsnun/ de'ang sku dang thugs gnyis la/ sku dang yig 'bru dbu ma'i yar sne'i haṃ yig la bstim/ de nyid sku'am yig 'bru dang dbyer med du gyur pa spyi bo'i yi dam gyi thugs kar rgyang gis bstim/ de nyid dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa'am mi dmigs par 'jog par gang bder bya'o// drug pa blo chod bar do'i rnal 'byor la gnyis/ sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ tshogs drug gi yul du snang chad thams cad bar do yin/ de'ang bden par ma grub snyam du nges shes bskyed la drag tu bsgom/ blo 'byangs nas nges par bar do yin snyam du thag chod pa na/ sgyu lus 'od gsal sogs rang nyid dge sbyor gang la goms pa de dang bsre nas lam du khyer zhing gnad du btang bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'chi bar gzhi'i 'od gsal 'char ba'i skabs lam gyi 'od gsal la goms pas 'od gsal ma bu 'phrod par ma gyur na/ srid pa bar do'i snang ba 'char bas skabs der sngar gyi goms stobs (432)kyis rgyu byas te/ bar do la bar do yin par shes pa'i tshe goms 'dris gang la che ba'i dge sbyor dang bsres te lam du btang*/ khyad par snang ba thams cad mi g.yo ba'i sku/ grags pa thams cad tsaṇ+ḍa ma'i sngags/ dran rtog thams cad rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes su rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ sgyu lus pas rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bsre ba rang byin rlabs kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ 'od gsal bas ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gang rung gis mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang*/ yang 'khrul snang 'char ba'i tshe zung 'jug gi lha skur ldang ba sogs kyis grol 'bras mngon tu byed par 'gyur ro// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gnyis// dngos dang*/ zhar byung ngo*// dang po ni/ mtshan bcas mtshan med rnal 'byor gang la 'jug kyang thams cad kyi rjes thog tu byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam khyad par can mang po gdab/

'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo ba dngos sam rjes mthun pas dge rtsa byang chub kyi rgya mtshor spel/ thun mtshams rnams su'ang dngos gzhi'i nyams myong dang ma bral ba'i dran shes kyis spyod lam la 'jug ste rnam pa kun tu nyams rtogs gong 'phel du 'gyur zhing sgo gsum don yod du 'gyur ba la bslab bo// gnyis pa zhar byung de thams cad stan thog gcig tu nyams su len na/ sngon 'gro yongs rdzogs sam/ bsdu na skyabs sems tshogs bsags tsam gyi rjes/ dngos gzhi lha'i rnal 'byor thun mong khyad par dang bcas rdzogs par bsgom pa'i mthar/ chos drug las gtum mo'i dmigs pa re dang*/ gzhan ji ltar rigs pa bsgom rjes 'od gsal du zhugs te/ zung 'jug tu ldangs nas/ srung ba'i rnal 'byor dang bcas thun mtshams la 'jug par bya'o// gnas skabs mthar thug yon tan kun// rnal 'byor 'di las 'byung ba'i phyir// zab cing rgya che'i bcud mchog (433)la// skom pas chu mtsho bzhin tu rol// bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid las mi g.yo chos drug gi khrid kyi le tshan no// jo bo yab sras zhal gyi lung*// gdams ngag lugs dang man ngag lugs// zung 'brel mdo sngags kun gyi bcud// bdag gi skal pa bzang pos thob// lung rtogs cha shas ma rdzogs pas// legs bshad 'od dkar spro ba'i mthu// dman kyang kun mkhyen bla ma'i bka'// spyi bor bkod nas zin chung sbrel// dge bas skye bo thams cad kyis// stong dang rten 'byung tshul rtogs shing*// zab lam bgrod pa'i mthu thob nas// zung 'jug go 'phang mngon byed shog /ces pa 'di'ang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi tshul ston pa khyab bdag thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas/ zab khrid bka' drin tu stsal ba'i tshe regs zig 'bri bar 'os pa'i bka' stsal gnang ba/ sher brtson dman pas gsung rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo las cha tsam yang 'dzin par ma nus kyang bsnyel bar phongs te/

rje nyid kyis gnang ba'i sa bcad rtsa bar bzung*/ smyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa dang*/ 'jam mgon kun dga' bsod nams kyi khrid yig gi legs cha btus/ rje btsun grol mchog zhabs kyi khrid yig gi tshig don gnyis ka'ang tshang ba'i lugs su byas te/ rang blos gang dpog gi zin bris su snyoms las pa yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi gdan sar bris pa bstan pa rin po che rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dge legs 'phel/// /(434)
